---
name: Feature request
about: A problem Nightfall should solve, or a sound it should have
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the situation, not the solution. "I can't fall asleep when the fan in my
room stops at 3 a.m." is more useful than "add a fan stop schedule" — the second
one is a guess about implementation and the first one is a fact about your night.

**What do you do today instead?**
Another app, a second phone, a physical fan. This tells us how much the gap
actually costs you.

**What would a good outcome look like?**
The behavior you would be satisfied with, in plain terms. If there are two
reasonable versions of it, describe both.

**Where does it live in the app?**
Home, Library, Studio, Presets or Settings, if you have an opinion. If it is a new
sound, say which family it belongs to and whether it is a recording or synthesis.

**What should it *not* do?**
Anything that would make this feature a bad idea: a permission it must not need, a
setting that should not exist, behavior that would surprise you.

---

For context on what is already planned and what will never be added, see
[ROADMAP.md](../blob/main/ROADMAP.md). Nightfall will not gain accounts, cloud
sync, analytics, advertising, a layer cap, or health and sleep-stage claims.

If you can write it yourself, [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) has
the build gate and the commit convention. Saying so here saves a round trip.
